mapper.insert: insert into ai_client_def(app_id, client_code, client_name, description, create_time, update_time) values (#{appId}, #{clientCode}, #{clientName}, #{description}, now(), now())

insert into ai_client_version(client_id, version, status, model_name, prompt_template, output_schema, create_time, update_time) values (#{clientId}, #{version}, #{status}, #{modelName}, #{promptTemplate}, #{outputSchema}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select version_id, client_id, version, status, model_name, prompt_template, output_schema, create_time, update_time from ai_client_version where client_id = #{clientId} and status = 'published' order by version_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update ai_client_version set status = 'deprecated', update_time = now() where client_id = #{clientId} and status = 'published'
update ai_client_version set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where version_id = #{versionId}
